chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from one of his men, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about the man who marries the woman by Mut'ah for a known number of days. So she comes to him during one of her days and says, 'I have committed adultery before my coming to you, by an hour or by a day.' Would it be permissible for him to sleep with her, and she has acknowledged to him her adultery? He said: 'It is not befitting for him to sleep with her.'

key_terms.يَطَأَهَا: He sleeps with her / consummates marriage

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a husband sleeping with his wife in temporary marriage if she admits to adultery?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that in temporary marriage (Mut'ah), if the wife admits to committing adultery (Zina) even shortly before the husband's visit, he should refrain from consummating the marriage. This ruling highlights the distinct legal status of the wife in Mut'ah, where her sexual purity is a condition for the husband's right to intimacy, distinguishing it from permanent marriage where adultery does not automatically void the marital bond in the same immediate manner.
